Common.notEmergency: C.A.B.L.E is not an emergency service and does not provide medical advice.

Landing.metaDescription: A synthetic Hindi-to-English voice care-coordination demonstration with explicit consent and caregiver approval.
Landing.headline: Care coordination that asks before it shares.
Landing.subhead: An elder speaks in Hindi, reviews exactly what C.A.B.L.E understood, and chooses what caregivers and a verified provider may receive in English.
Landing.membershipRequiredTitle: Your WorkOS account is signed in but is not ready for C.A.B.L.E
Landing.membershipRequiredBody: {email} has no organization membership with an elder or caregiver role. Add the account to your WorkOS organization with one of those exact role slugs, then sign out and sign in again.
Landing.reassurance: Nothing personal leaves the private session without specific, current permission.
Landing.confirmBody: The elder corrects what C.A.B.L.E heard before any disclosure question appears.
Landing.consentBody: Permission names exact details, recipients, channels, purpose, language, and expiry.
Landing.approveBody: A caregiver reviews the immutable English message before a deterministic policy gate may queue it.
Landing.safetyBody: Use fictional personas and synthetic health information only. This prototype is not clinically validated, does not diagnose or recommend treatment, does not override consent, and never calls emergency services automatically.

Elder.title: Good afternoon, {name}.
Elder.subtitle: Your check-in starts privately. You decide whether anything is shared.
Elder.privacyBody: Caregivers cannot see a transcript or draft. They see only an exact update after you clearly agree.

Caregiver.title: Today
Caregiver.subtitle: Consent-scoped updates and actions that need a human decision.
Caregiver.emptyBody: Connect WorkOS and Convex to load authorized care-circle data. The separate synthetic demo never appears here.
